Name: Resourceful Friends
Author: ItsBenter
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/LQeyWhM.png[/img]
This mod has five farm animals. They produce existing game resources, effectively enabling a steady supply. Three of the farm animals are meant for Coop and two are meant for Barn. This mod also has a fish like addition to produce jellies.

[list]
[*][url=https://github.com/itsbenter/ResourcefulFriends/blob/main/Documentation/Coalclaw.md]Coalclaw[/url]﻿ - Produce coal
[*][url=https://github.com/itsbenter/ResourcefulFriends/blob/main/Documentation/Honeypuff.md]Honeypuff[/url]﻿ - Produce honey
[*][url=https://github.com/itsbenter/ResourcefulFriends/blob/main/Documentation/Molecat.md]Molecat[/url]﻿ - Produce ores
[*][url=https://github.com/itsbenter/ResourcefulFriends/blob/main/Documentation/Petalkin.md]Petalkin [/url]﻿- Produce forages
[*][url=https://github.com/itsbenter/ResourcefulFriends/blob/main/Documentation/Timberbark.md]Timberbark [/url]﻿- Produce woods
[/list]
Details can be found in [url=https://github.com/itsbenter/ResourcefulFriends]GitHub[/url]﻿.
Note: I'd like to have progression to unlock the farm animals but ended up too caught up with other stuff to properly do it. As this mod has remained WIP and not touched for too long I decided to go ahead release. Feel free to expand and build on this mod.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/CqcVhaz.png[/img]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23228]Better Truffles[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16879]Better Pigs[/url]﻿. Is not only compatible but also recommended. Gives Coalclaw and Molecat easier time to produce and give bubbles to easily spot where the produces are.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]. Petalkin will produce the forages added by SVE.
[*]Recolor mods. The mod visual might look janky with some recolors. Authors are welcomed to make compatibility patches. Refer to [url=https://github.com/itsbenter/ResourcefulFriends/blob/main/Documentation/Compatibility.md]Compatibility[/url]
[/list]
Some more info can be found in the [url=https://github.com/itsbenter/ResourcefulFriends/blob/main/Documentation/Compatibility.md]Compatibility section[/url]﻿.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/WtvzZ9s.png[/img]

[*]Valefor, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/185632473]poohnhi[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/74479268]fellowclown[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1249127]DolphinIsNotaFish[/url], and many others that accompany me and be soundboard in making this mod.
